title: El chisme vuelve
desc: Something you said in confidence comes back improved
setting: Doña Chepa leans over the counter with news about you that you have not heard yet.

steps.speaker: Doña Chepa
steps.es: Ideay, ¿y es cierto que se van del barrio?
steps.en: Ideay, is it true that you are leaving the barrio?

options.es: ¿Quién le dijo eso? Nosotros buscamos casa aquí cerca.
options.en: Who told you that? We are looking for a house near here.
options.feedback: Correcting it at the counter is the fastest way to correct it everywhere. This is where the barrio reads its news.
A denial with no replacement. The old version will keep travelling.

options.es: Eso no es asunto de nadie.
options.feedback: In this barrio it already is, and now you have made an enemy of the printing press.

steps.speaker: Doña Chepa
steps.es: Ah, entonces no se van lejos.
steps.en: Ah, so you are not going far.

options.es: Tres cuadras. Ni salimos del barrio.
options.en: Three blocks. We are not even leaving the barrio.
options.feedback: A number and a boundary. That is the version that will be repeated tonight, word for word.
Vague, and vague is what gossip fills in.
Uncertainty is the raw material. You have just given her more of it.

steps.speaker: Doña Chepa
steps.es: Es que me contaron que se iban para afuera.
steps.en: The thing is I was told you were going abroad.

options.es: Fijese que a doña Elena le llegó así y se puso a llorar.
options.en: The thing is, it reached doña Elena like that and she started crying.
options.feedback: Showing the cost, without blaming her, is the one thing that makes a barrio careful about a story.

options.en: Well, no, we are staying here.
options.feedback: Clear and correct. It corrects the fact without fixing the harm.

options.en: You are the one going around saying it.
options.feedback: Probably true. Saying it to her face ends a four-year relationship over a rumour.

steps.speaker: Doña Chepa
steps.es: Ay, no. Yo le aviso a la gente entonces.
steps.en: Oh no. I will let people know, then.

options.es: Gracias, doña. Usted es la que sabe.
options.en: Thank you, doña. You are the one who knows.
options.feedback: You just turned the biggest gossip on the block into your correction service. That is the whole strategy.
Fine. It accepts the offer without making her want to do it well.

options.es: Ojalá esta vez salga bien la historia.
options.en: Hopefully the story comes out right this time.
options.feedback: One small barb, and now the correction travels slower than the rumour did.
